description: This Java class 'PageStatistics' extends 'Statistics' and provides methods to analyze books in a reading shelf, including finding the book with the most pages and calculating the average page length for read books.

classes.name: PageStatistics
classes.description: A class that provides statistical analysis on books, such as finding the book with the most pages and calculating average pages read.

methods.name: findBookWithMostPages
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the book with the highest number of pages from the 'read' shelf.

methods.name: findBooksWithPageCountSpecified
methods.description: Private method that filters books with a non-null page count from the 'read' shelf.

methods.name: calculateAveragePageLength
methods.description: Calculates the average number of pages for books with specified page counts in the 'read' shelf.
